prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE entirely NEW bright realistic COLOR PHOTOGRAPH, vertical3:4,1086x1448 or larger native3:4, for a Qing palace memory scene. Full rectangular opaque photo with no border, oval mask, fade, vignette, text or captions.
Camera low at the edge of a pale stone table in a summer pavilion. The main subject is a SMALL handless doucai porcelain tea cup, palm-sized, about7cm wide and5cm tall, standing on the table in crisp focus. Fine white thin porcelain, delicate restrained blue outlines and small green/red/yellow enamel motifs; it is a tiny drinking cup, not a bowl or vase. Give the cup breathing room on the tabletop, close but not exaggerated macro scale.
Above the cup, in the air, a small feathered jianzi kicking toy is caught in flight with gentle motion blur. It has several short feathers joined to a tiny weighted base. The toy is separate from the cup and does not overlap its rim.
FAR in the background in the sunny courtyard, indistinct small figures wearing yellow and dark navy Qing robes are playing a kicking game. Their bodies and faces are softly out of focus and occupy a small part of the frame. No nearby faces or foreground hands. Main visual hierarchy: sharp tiny porcelain cup, airborne feather toy, distant blurred courtyard activity.
Natural daylight, airy summer atmosphere, subtle real-camera depth of field, authentic porcelain glaze and stone texture, lifelike photographic surface. No painting, illustration, CGI, artificial repeated texture, modern equipment, labels, lettering, logos or watermark. Entirely new image, no edit target.
